=== the title is empty

=== the brief is too short
orchestrator: add_task {"title":"Read","brief":"Read it.","kind":"research","writes":false,"tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A later task checks it."}
refusal:
the brief is too short to work from: its agent knows nothing but the brief

=== the kind is no word
orchestrator: add_task {"title":"Read","brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"!!!","writes":false,"tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A later task checks it."}
refusal:
kind must be one short word, e.g. research, implement, review

=== the kind starts with a digit

kind must be one short word, e.g. research, implement, review

=== writes is not a boolean

=== depends_on is not a list
orchestrator: add_task {"title":"Read","brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","writes":false,"tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A later task checks it.","depends_on":"T01"}
refusal:
depends_on must be a list of task ids

=== depends_on names tasks that do not exist

=== needs_report is not a list
orchestrator: add_task {"title":"Read","brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","writes":false,"tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A later task checks it.","needs_report":"T01"}
refusal:
needs_report must be a list of task ids

=== needs_report names a task it does not depend on
orchestrator: add_task {"title":"Read","brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","writes":false,"tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A later task checks it.","needs_report":["T01"]}
refusal:
needs_report names tasks this one does not depend on: T01. Add them to depends_on as well.

=== the notes gate
orchestrator: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"implement","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Build the importer","writes":true}
refusal:
The notes are empty, so a task that changes files is refused. First record with set_notes what the goal requires, what done means and how it will be checked, and the approach the facts support. If you cannot write that yet, the run needs tasks that investigate (writes: false) before tasks that build.

refusal:
The run's notes are empty, so a task that changes files is refused: the orchestrator has not yet recorded what done means. Add a task that investigates (writes: false), or tell the orchestrator what the person wants.
